integrity: The primary source was inspected at the continuity theorem, graph criterion, and explicit quadratic-graph example. The source's sufficient bound was replaced by an exact calculation on the divisor-boundary intersection. The separate global outwardness threshold was derived by exact phase minimization on the unit sphere. Current and prior research ledgers and published-finding searches were checked for source, formula, alias, and implication overlap.
scientific_limitations: The unrestricted parameter result is specific to the two disjoint quadratic graphs z2 = epsilon z1^2 plus or minus a in the unit ball. It does not give an explicit envelope formula, an optimal modulus of continuity, or an unrestricted higher-degree graph theorem.
title: Unrestricted quadratic-graph Dirichlet continuity beyond the half-curvature threshold
